title: A Safehouse for the Debt
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Ulyana Oyelaran, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
